title: pvGenerateProcessIds
body:
## pvGenerateProcessIds

Deprecated alias of pvProcessIds (ParaView marks GenerateProcessIds deprecated in 5.13, to be removed in 5.14): it adds PointProcessIds and/or CellProcessIds arrays giving the owning MPI process of each point or cell. Prefer pvProcessIds for new workflows; behaviour is the same.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Expect this operation to disappear when Schemaxis absorbs ParaView 5.14.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI or client-server behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GenerateProcessIds`. Identity: `filters/GenerateProcessIds`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GenerateCellData` | The value of this property determines whether to generate process id for cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GeneratePointData` | The value of this property determines whether to generate process id for points. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGenerateProcessIds",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
